entities.summary: Daniil Vadimovich Tarasov is a Russian professional ice hockey player who is a goaltender for the Florida Panthers of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was drafted 86th overall by the Columbus Blue Jackets in the third round of the 2017 NHL entry draft.
